'''''Pepper's Hope''''' was a stock [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] light [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was owned and utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and operative [[Margo Flarestream]], while she was stationed at [[Fabrillan]].<ref name="CRO" />
